mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals an improving labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic output, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures and nonfarm payrolls by more than 0.5% in a month signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and PAYEMS increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both RSAFS and PAYEMS increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the consumer price index signals inflationary pressure, which erodes real returns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decrease in real GDP and housing starts by more than 1% in a quarter signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST decrease > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decreased by more than 1% in a quarter.
